def collect_files(paths, recursive, symlink, skip_vcs, skip_gitignore, parent_ignore, skipped, bin_check_bytes, binary_enabled):
    files=[]
    skipped_msgs=[]
    parent_found_paths=set()

    if not paths:
        paths=["."]

    for p in paths:
        if not os.path.exists(p):
            continue
        if os.path.isfile(p):
            skip=False
            reason=""
            if skip_vcs and is_vcs_path(p):
                skip=True
                reason="vcs file"
            elif not binary_enabled and is_binary_file(p, bin_check_bytes):
                skip=True
                reason="binary"
            else:
                if skip_gitignore:
                    d=os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(p)) or "."
                    pats=load_gitignore_patterns(d)
                    if matches_gitignore(p, d, pats):
                        skip=True
                        reason=".gitignore"
                if not skip and parent_ignore:
                    cur_dir=os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(p))
                    cur=cur_dir
                    while True:
                        parent=os.path.dirname(cur)
                        if parent==cur:
                            break
                        gi=os.path.join(parent,".gitignore")
                        if os.path.isfile(gi):
                            pats=load_gitignore_patterns(parent)
                            if matches_gitignore(p, parent, pats):
                                skip=True
                                reason=".gitignore"
                                parent_found_paths.add(parent)
                                break
                        cur=parent
            if skip:
                if skipped:
                    if reason=="vcs file":
                        skipped_msgs.append(f'Skip (vcs file)  : "{p}"')
                    elif reason=="binary":
                        skipped_msgs.append(f'Skip (binary)    : "{p}"')
                    elif reason==".gitignore":
                        skipped_msgs.append(f'Skip (.gitignore): "{p}"')
                    else:
                        skipped_msgs.append(f'Skip ({reason}): "{p}"')
                continue
            files.append(p)
        elif os.path.isdir(p):
            if parent_ignore:
                parent=find_parent_gitignore(p)
                if parent:
                    parent_found_paths.add(parent)
            for root, dirs, filenames in os.walk(p, topdown=True, followlinks=symlink):
                if skip_vcs:
                    dirs[:]=[d for d in dirs if d not in (".git",".hg",".svn",".bzr")]
                if not recursive and os.path.abspath(root)!=os.path.abspath(p):
                    dirs[:]=[]
                    continue
                pats_here=[]
                if skip_gitignore:
                    pats_here=load_gitignore_patterns(root)
                for fname in filenames:
                    fpath=os.path.join(root, fname)
                    if not symlink and os.path.islink(fpath):
                        if skipped:
                            skipped_msgs.append(f'Skip (symlink)    : "{fpath}"')
                        continue
                    if skip_vcs and is_vcs_path(fpath):
                        if skipped:
                            skipped_msgs.append(f'Skip (vcs file)  : "{fpath}"')
                        continue
                    if not binary_enabled and is_binary_file(fpath, bin_check_bytes):
                        if skipped:
                            skipped_msgs.append(f'Skip (binary)    : "{fpath}"')
                        continue
                    if skip_gitignore and matches_gitignore(fpath, root, pats_here):
                        if skipped:
                            skipped_msgs.append(f'Skip (.gitignore): "{fpath}"')
                        continue
                    if parent_ignore:
                        cur_dir=os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(fpath))
                        cur=cur_dir
                        found_parent=None
                        while True:
                            par=os.path.dirname(cur)
                            if par==cur:
                                break
                            gi=os.path.join(par,".gitignore")
                            if os.path.isfile(gi):
                                ppats=load_gitignore_patterns(par)
                                if matches_gitignore(fpath, par, ppats):
                                    found_parent=par
                                    break
                            cur=par
                        if found_parent:
                            if skipped:
                                skipped_msgs.append(f'Skip (.gitignore): "{fpath}"')
                            parent_found_paths.add(found_parent)
                            continue
                    files.append(fpath)
    return files, skipped_msgs, parent_found_paths

    max_threads = options["max_threads"]

    files, skipped_msgs, parent_found_set = collect_files(
        paths,
        recursive=use_recursive,
        symlink=use_symlink,
        skip_vcs=use_skip_vcs,
        skip_gitignore=use_skip_gitignore,
        parent_ignore=use_parent_ignore,
        skipped=use_skipped,
        bin_check_bytes=bin_check_bytes,
        binary_enabled=use_binary
    )

    parent_messages=[]
    if use_parent_ignore:
        for search_path in (paths if paths else ["."]):
            abs_path=os.path.abspath(search_path)
            if os.path.isfile(abs_path):
                cur_dir=os.path.dirname(abs_path)
            else:
                cur_dir=abs_path
            cur=cur_dir
            while True:
                parent=os.path.dirname(cur)
                if parent==cur:
                    break
                if os.path.isfile(os.path.join(parent,".gitignore")):
                    try:
                        rel=os.path.relpath(parent, cur_dir)
                    except:
                        rel=parent
                    if rel=="..":
                        rel_disp="./.."
                    else:
                        if not rel.startswith("."):
                            rel_disp="./"+rel
                        else:
                            if rel.startswith("..") and not rel.startswith("./"):
                                rel_disp="./"+rel
                            else:
                                rel_disp=rel
                    parent_messages.append(rel_disp)
                    break
                cur=parent
        for pf in parent_found_set:
            base_dir = os.path.abspath(paths[0]) if paths else os.path.abspath(".")
            if os.path.isfile(base_dir):
                base_dir=os.path.dirname(base_dir)
            try:
                rel=os.path.relpath(pf, base_dir)

                rel=pf
            if rel=="..":
                rel_disp="./.."
            else:
                if not rel.startswith("."):
                    rel_disp="./"+rel
                else:
                    if rel.startswith("..") and not rel.startswith("./"):

                    else:

    if use_fixed_order:
        files=sorted(files)

    if use_regex:
        keyword_py = re.sub(r'\(\?<([a-zA-Z_]\w*)>', r'(?P<\1>', keyword)
        try:

        except re.error as e:

    else:

    def regex_replace_func(m_obj, rep_str):
        res=""
        i=0
        while i < len(rep_str):
            if rep_str[i]=='$':
                if i+1 < len(rep_str) and rep_str[i+1]=='$':
                    res+='$'
                    i+=2
                    continue
                if i+1 < len(rep_str) and rep_str[i+1]=='{':
                    j=rep_str.find('}', i+2)
                    if j!=-1:
                        inner=rep_str[i+2:j]
                        if inner.isdigit():
                            try:
                                res+=m_obj.group(int(inner))
                            except:
                                pass
                        else:
                            try:
                                res+=m_obj.group(inner)
                            except:
                                pass
                        i=j+1
                        continue
                j=i+1
                if j < len(rep_str) and rep_str[j].isdigit():
                    num=""
                    while j < len(rep_str) and rep_str[j].isdigit():
                        num+=rep_str[j]
                        j+=1
                    try:
                        res+=m_obj.group(int(num))
                    except:
                        pass
                    i=j
                    continue
                elif j < len(rep_str) and (rep_str[j].isalpha() or rep_str[j]=='_'):
                    name=""
                    while j < len(rep_str) and (rep_str[j].isalnum() or rep_str[j]=='_'):
                        name+=rep_str[j]
                        j+=1
                    try:
                        res+=m_obj.group(name)
                    except:
                        pass
                    i=j
                    continue
                else:

        else:

            quit_file=False

            for (line_idx, orig_col, match_len, match_text, match_obj, orig_line_text) in matches:

                rep_preview = regex_replace_func(match_obj, replacement) if use_regex else replacement
                replaced_line = orig_line_text[:orig_col] + rep_preview + orig_line_text[orig_col+match_len:]

                if line_idx==0:

                row_str = f"{col_num}:" if use_row else ""

                if use_file:

                else:
                    prefix_content = col_str+row_str
                    first_prefix = prefix_content.ljust(4)

                second_prefix = " "*(len(first_prefix)-3) + "-> "

                if use_color:
                    before = orig_line_text[:orig_col]
                    after = orig_line_text[orig_col+match_len:]
                    if use_file:
                        first = f"\x1b[32m{fpath}\x1b[36m: {col_str}{row_str}"
                        if before:
                            first += f"\x1b[37m{before}"
                        first += f"\x1b[33m{match_text}\x1b[37m{after}"
                        second = f"\x1b[36m{second_prefix}"
                        if before:
                            second += f"\x1b[37m{before}"
                        second += f"\x1b[33m{rep_preview}\x1b[37m{after}"
                    else:
                        first = f"\x1b[36m{first_prefix}"
                        if before:
                            first += f"\x1b[37m{before}"
                        first += f"\x1b[33m{match_text}\x1b[37m{after}"
                        second = f"\x1b[36m{second_prefix}"

                            second += f"\x1b[37m{before}"
                        second += f"\x1b[33m{rep_preview}\x1b[37m{after}"

                else:

                    sys.stdout.write(f"{second_prefix}{replaced_line}\n")
                    sys.stdout.write("Replace keyword? [Y]es/[n]o/[a]ll/[q]uit: ")
                sys.stdout.flush()

                while True:
                    try:
                        user_in = input().strip()
                    except EOFError:
                        user_in="q"
                    low=user_in.lower()
                    if low in ("y","yes","n","no","a","all","q","quit"):
                        break
                    else:
                        if use_color:
                            sys.stdout.write(f"\x1b[36mReplace keyword? [Y]es/[n]o/[a]ll/[q]uit: {RESET}")
                        else:
                            sys.stdout.write("Replace keyword? [Y]es/[n]o/[a]ll/[q]uit: ")
                        sys.stdout.flush()

                low=user_in.lower()
                if low in ("y","yes"):
                    actual_col=orig_col+shifts[line_idx]
                    m_line=mutable_lines[line_idx]
                    rep = regex_replace_func(match_obj, replacement) if use_regex else replacement
                    new_m_line=m_line[:actual_col]+rep+m_line[actual_col+match_len:]
                    mutable_lines[line_idx]=new_m_line
                    shifts[line_idx]+=len(rep)-match_len
                elif low in ("n","no"):
                    continue
                elif low in ("a","all"):
                    actual_col=orig_col+shifts[line_idx]
                    m_line=mutable_lines[line_idx]
                    rep = regex_replace_func(match_obj, replacement) if use_regex else replacement
                    new_m_line=m_line[:actual_col]+rep+m_line[actual_col+match_len:]
                    mutable_lines[line_idx]=new_m_line
                    shifts[line_idx]+=len(rep)-match_len
                    all_flag=True
                elif low in ("q","quit"):
                    quit_file=True
                    break

                new_content="\n".join(mutable_lines)
                if has_trailing_newline:

                        st=os.stat(fpath)
                        atime=st.st_atime
                        mtime=st.st_mtime

        else:
            sys.stdout.write(f"\nStatistics\n  Max threads: {max_threads}\n\n  Consumed time ( busy / total )\n    Find     : 0s / {elapsed:.7f}s\n")
            for idx in range(num_match_threads):
                sys.stdout.write(f"    Match{idx:02d}  : 0s / {elapsed:.7f}s\n")
            sys.stdout.write(f"    Sort     : 0s / {elapsed:.7f}s\n    Replace  : 0s / {elapsed:.7f}s\n\n")

    sys.exit(0)

if __name__=="__main__":
    main()

    return {}

def is_vcs_path(path):
    parts=pathlib.Path(path).parts
    for p in parts:
        if p in (".git",".hg",".svn",".bzr"):
            return True
    return False

def is_binary_file(path, bin_check_bytes):
    try:
        with open(path,'rb') as f:
            data=f.read(bin_check_bytes)
            return b'\x00' in data
    except:
        return False

def load_gitignore_patterns(dir_path):
    patterns=[]
    gi_path=os.path.join(dir_path,".gitignore")
    if os.path.isfile(gi_path):
        try:
            with open(gi_path,'r') as f:
                for line in f:
                    line=line.strip()
                    if not line or line.startswith("#"):
                        continue
                    patterns.append(line)
        except:
            pass
    return patterns

def matches_gitignore(file_path, base_dir, patterns):
    try:
        rel=os.path.relpath(file_path, base_dir)
    except:
        rel=file_path
    for pat in patterns:
        pat=pat.rstrip("/")
        if not pat:
            continue
        if fnmatch.fnmatch(rel, pat) or fnmatch.fnmatch(os.path.basename(file_path), pat):
            return True
        if fnmatch.fnmatch(rel, pat+"/*"):
            return True
    return False

def find_parent_gitignore(start_dir):
    cur=os.path.abspath(start_dir)
    if os.path.isfile(cur):
        cur=os.path.dirname(cur)
    while True:
        parent=os.path.dirname(cur)
        if parent==cur:
            break
        gi=os.path.join(parent,".gitignore")
        if os.path.isfile(gi):
            return parent
        cur=parent
    return None

def collect_files(paths, recursive, symlink, skip_vcs, skip_gitignore, parent_ignore, skipped, bin_check_bytes, binary_enabled):
    files=[]
    skipped_msgs=[]
    parent_found_paths=set()

    if not paths:
        paths=["."]

    for p in paths:
        if not os.path.exists(p):
            continue
        if os.path.isfile(p):
            skip=False
            reason=""
            if skip_vcs and is_vcs_path(p):
                skip=True
                reason="vcs file"
            elif not binary_enabled and is_binary_file(p, bin_check_bytes):
                skip=True
                reason="binary"
            else:
                if skip_gitignore:
                    d=os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(p)) or "."
                    pats=load_gitignore_patterns(d)
                    if matches_gitignore(p, d, pats):
                        skip=True
                        reason=".gitignore"
                if not skip and parent_ignore:
                    cur_dir=os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(p))
                    cur=cur_dir
                    while True:
                        parent=os.path.dirname(cur)
                        if parent==cur:
                            break
                        gi=os.path.join(parent,".gitignore")
                        if os.path.isfile(gi):
                            pats=load_gitignore_patterns(parent)
                            if matches_gitignore(p, parent, pats):
                                skip=True
                                reason=".gitignore"
                                parent_found_paths.add(parent)
                                break
                        cur=parent
            if skip:
                if skipped:
                    if reason=="vcs file":
                        skipped_msgs.append(f'Skip (vcs file)  : "{p}"')
                    elif reason=="binary":
                        skipped_msgs.append(f'Skip (binary)    : "{p}"')
                    elif reason==".gitignore":
                        skipped_msgs.append(f'Skip (.gitignore): "{p}"')
                    else:
                        skipped_msgs.append(f'Skip ({reason}): "{p}"')
                continue
            files.append(p)
        elif os.path.isdir(p):
            if parent_ignore:
                parent=find_parent_gitignore(p)
                if parent:
                    parent_found_paths.add(parent)
            for root, dirs, filenames in os.walk(p, topdown=True, followlinks=symlink):
                if skip_vcs:
                    dirs[:]=[d for d in dirs if d not in (".git",".hg",".svn",".bzr")]
                if not recursive and os.path.abspath(root)!=os.path.abspath(p):
                    dirs[:]=[]
                    continue
                pats_here=[]
                if skip_gitignore:
                    pats_here=load_gitignore_patterns(root)
                for fname in filenames:
                    fpath=os.path.join(root, fname)
                    if not symlink and os.path.islink(fpath):
                        if skipped:
                            skipped_msgs.append(f'Skip (symlink)    : "{fpath}"')
                        continue
                    if skip_vcs and is_vcs_path(fpath):
                        if skipped:
                            skipped_msgs.append(f'Skip (vcs file)  : "{fpath}"')
                        continue
                    if not binary_enabled and is_binary_file(fpath, bin_check_bytes):
                        if skipped:
                            skipped_msgs.append(f'Skip (binary)    : "{fpath}"')
                        continue
                    if skip_gitignore and matches_gitignore(fpath, root, pats_here):
                        if skipped:
                            skipped_msgs.append(f'Skip (.gitignore): "{fpath}"')
                        continue
                    if parent_ignore:
                        cur_dir=os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(fpath))
                        cur=cur_dir
                        found_parent=None
                        while True:
                            par=os.path.dirname(cur)
                            if par==cur:
                                break
                            gi=os.path.join(par,".gitignore")
                            if os.path.isfile(gi):
                                ppats=load_gitignore_patterns(par)
                                if matches_gitignore(fpath, par, ppats):
                                    found_parent=par
                                    break
                            cur=par
                        if found_parent:
                            if skipped:
                                skipped_msgs.append(f'Skip (.gitignore): "{fpath}"')
                            parent_found_paths.add(found_parent)
                            continue
                    files.append(fpath)
    return files, skipped_msgs, parent_found_paths

                    res+='$'

                j=i+1
                if j < len(rep_str) and rep_str[j].isdigit():
                    num=""

                        num+=rep_str[j]
                        j+=1
                    try:
                        res+=m_obj.group(int(num))

                        pass
                    i=j
                    continue
                elif j < len(rep_str) and (rep_str[j].isalpha() or rep_str[j]=='_'):

                    i=j
                    continue

def parse_toml_simple(path):
    cfg={}
    try:
        with open(path,'r') as f:
            for line in f:
                line=line.strip()
                if not line or line.startswith("#"):
                    continue
                if "=" not in line:
                    continue
                k,v=line.split("=",1)
                k=k.strip()
                v=v.strip()
                if v.lower()=="true":
                    cfg[k]=True
                elif v.lower()=="false":
                    cfg[k]=False
                else:
                    try:
                        cfg[k]=int(v)
                    except:
                        cfg[k]=v.strip('"').strip("'")
    except:
        pass
    return cfg

    parts=pathlib.Path(path).parts
    for p in parts:
        if p in (".git",".hg",".svn",".bzr"):
            return True
    return False

def is_binary_file(path, bin_check_bytes):
    try:
        with open(path,'rb') as f:
            data=f.read(bin_check_bytes)
            return b'\x00' in data
    except:
        return False

def load_gitignore_patterns(dir_path):
    patterns=[]
    gi_path=os.path.join(dir_path,".gitignore")
    if os.path.isfile(gi_path):
        try:
            with open(gi_path,'r') as f:
                for line in f:
                    line=line.strip()
                    if not line or line.startswith("#"):
                        continue
                    patterns.append(line)
        except:
            pass
    return patterns

def matches_gitignore(file_path, base_dir, patterns):
    try:
        rel=os.path.relpath(file_path, base_dir)
    except:
        rel=file_path
    for pat in patterns:
        pat=pat.rstrip("/")
        if not pat:
            continue
        if fnmatch.fnmatch(rel, pat) or fnmatch.fnmatch(os.path.basename(file_path), pat):
            return True
        if fnmatch.fnmatch(rel, pat+"/*"):
            return True
    return False

def find_parent_gitignore(start_dir):
    cur=os.path.abspath(start_dir)
    if os.path.isfile(cur):
        cur=os.path.dirname(cur)
    while True:
        parent=os.path.dirname(cur)
        if parent==cur:
            break
        gi=os.path.join(parent,".gitignore")
        if os.path.isfile(gi):
            return parent
        cur=parent
    return None

                        reason=".gitignore"
                if not skip and parent_ignore:
                    cur_dir=os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(p))
                    cur=cur_dir
                    while True:

                        if parent==cur:

                        gi=os.path.join(parent,".gitignore")
                        if os.path.isfile(gi):

                    if skip_gitignore and matches_gitignore(fpath, root, pats_here):

                        while True:

                low=user_in.lower()

                    mutable_lines[line_idx]=new_m_line
                    shifts[line_idx]+=len(rep)-match_len
                elif low in ("n","no"):

                elif low in ("a","all"):

                    m_line=mutable_lines[line_idx]
                    rep = regex_replace_func(match_obj, replacement) if use_regex else replacement
                    new_m_line=m_line[:actual_col]+rep+m_line[actual_col+match_len:]
                    mutable_lines[line_idx]=new_m_line
                    shifts[line_idx]+=len(rep)-match_len
                    all_flag=True
                elif low in ("q","quit"):

                    break

            if not quit_file:
                new_content="\n".join(mutable_lines)
                if has_trailing_newline:
                    new_content+="\n"
                if new_content!=content:

                        atime=st.st_atime
                        mtime=st.st_mtime
                    with open(fpath,'w',encoding='utf-8',errors='ignore') as out:

            for idx in range(num_match_threads):

            sys.stdout.write(f"    Sort     : 0s / {elapsed:.7f}s\n    Replace  : 0s / {elapsed:.7f}s\n\n")

    sys.exit(0)

if __name__=="__main__":
    main()

def print_error_duplicate(flag):
    sys.stderr.write(f"{RED_BOLD}error:{RESET} The argument '{YELLOW}{flag}{RESET}' was provided more than once, but cannot be used multiple times\n\n")
    fixed = ["--bin-check-bytes <BYTES>", "--max-threads <NUM>", "--mmap-bytes <BYTES>", "--size-per-thread <BYTES>"]
    items = fixed + [flag]
    def kf(s):
        return s.split()[0]
    seen=set()
    dedup=[]
    for it in items:
        k=it.split()[0]
        if k not in seen:
            seen.add(k)
            dedup.append(it)
    sorted_items = sorted(dedup, key=kf)
    usage = " ".join([f"{BIN} <KEYWORD> <REPLACEMENT>"] + sorted_items)
    sys.stderr.write(f"USAGE:\n    {usage}\n\n")
    sys.stderr.write(f"For more information try {GREEN}--help{RESET}\n")

    fixed = ["--bin-check-bytes <BYTES>", "--max-threads <NUM>", "--mmap-bytes <BYTES>", "--size-per-thread <BYTES>"]
    all_items = fixed + provided
    seen=set()

def parse_toml_simple(path):
    cfg={}
    try:
        with open(path,'r') as f:
            for line in f:
                line=line.strip()
                if not line or line.startswith("#"):
                    continue
                if "=" not in line:
                    continue
                k,v=line.split("=",1)
                k=k.strip()
                v=v.strip()
                if v.lower()=="true":
                    cfg[k]=True
                elif v.lower()=="false":
                    cfg[k]=False
                else:
                    try:
                        cfg[k]=int(v)
                    except:
                        cfg[k]=v.strip('"').strip("'")
    except:
        pass
    return cfg

def load_config():
    home=os.path.expanduser("~")
    ordered=[
        os.path.join(home,".ambr.toml"),
        os.path.join(home,".config","amber","ambr.toml"),
        "/etc/amber/ambr.toml",
        os.path.join(home,".ambs.toml"),
        os.path.join(home,".config","amber","ambs.toml"),
        "/etc/amber/ambs.toml",
    ]
    for cand in ordered:
        if os.path.isfile(cand):
            return parse_toml_simple(cand)
    return {}

def is_vcs_path(path):
    parts=pathlib.Path(path).parts
    for p in parts:
        if p in (".git",".hg",".svn",".bzr"):
            return True
    return False

def is_binary_file(path, bin_check_bytes):
    try:
        with open(path,'rb') as f:
            data=f.read(bin_check_bytes)
            return b'\x00' in data
    except:
        return False

def load_gitignore_patterns(dir_path):
    patterns=[]
    gi_path=os.path.join(dir_path,".gitignore")
    if os.path.isfile(gi_path):
        try:
            with open(gi_path,'r') as f:
                for line in f:
                    line=line.strip()
                    if not line or line.startswith("#"):
                        continue
                    patterns.append(line)
        except:
            pass
    return patterns

def matches_gitignore(file_path, base_dir, patterns):
    try:
        rel=os.path.relpath(file_path, base_dir)
    except:
        rel=file_path
    for pat in patterns:
        pat=pat.rstrip("/")
        if not pat:
            continue
        if fnmatch.fnmatch(rel, pat) or fnmatch.fnmatch(os.path.basename(file_path), pat):
            return True
        if fnmatch.fnmatch(rel, pat+"/*"):
            return True
    return False

def find_parent_gitignore(start_dir):
    cur=os.path.abspath(start_dir)
    if os.path.isfile(cur):
        cur=os.path.dirname(cur)
    while True:
        parent=os.path.dirname(cur)
        if parent==cur:
            break
        gi=os.path.join(parent,".gitignore")
        if os.path.isfile(gi):
            return parent
        cur=parent
    return None

def collect_files(paths, recursive, symlink, skip_vcs, skip_gitignore, parent_ignore, skipped, bin_check_bytes, binary_enabled):
    files=[]
    skipped_msgs=[]
    parent_found_paths=set()

    if not paths:
        paths=["."]

    for p in paths:
        if not os.path.exists(p):
            continue
        if os.path.isfile(p):
            skip=False
            reason=""
            if skip_vcs and is_vcs_path(p):
                skip=True
                reason="vcs file"
            elif not binary_enabled and is_binary_file(p, bin_check_bytes):
                skip=True
                reason="binary"
            else:
                if skip_gitignore:
                    d=os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(p)) or "."
                    pats=load_gitignore_patterns(d)
                    if matches_gitignore(p, d, pats):
                        skip=True
                        reason=".gitignore"
                if not skip and parent_ignore:
                    cur_dir=os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(p))
                    cur=cur_dir
                    while True:
                        parent=os.path.dirname(cur)
                        if parent==cur:
                            break
                        gi=os.path.join(parent,".gitignore")
                        if os.path.isfile(gi):
                            pats=load_gitignore_patterns(parent)
                            if matches_gitignore(p, parent, pats):
                                skip=True
                                reason=".gitignore"
                                parent_found_paths.add(parent)
                                break
                        cur=parent
            if skip:
                if skipped:
                    if reason=="vcs file":
                        skipped_msgs.append(f'Skip (vcs file)  : "{p}"')
                    elif reason=="binary":
                        skipped_msgs.append(f'Skip (binary)    : "{p}"')
                    elif reason==".gitignore":
                        skipped_msgs.append(f'Skip (.gitignore): "{p}"')
                    else:
                        skipped_msgs.append(f'Skip ({reason}): "{p}"')
                continue
            files.append(p)
        elif os.path.isdir(p):
            if parent_ignore:
                parent=find_parent_gitignore(p)
                if parent:
                    parent_found_paths.add(parent)
            for root, dirs, filenames in os.walk(p, topdown=True, followlinks=symlink):
                if skip_vcs:
                    dirs[:]=[d for d in dirs if d not in (".git",".hg",".svn",".bzr")]
                if not recursive and os.path.abspath(root)!=os.path.abspath(p):
                    dirs[:]=[]
                    continue
                pats_here=[]
                if skip_gitignore:
                    pats_here=load_gitignore_patterns(root)
                for fname in filenames:
                    fpath=os.path.join(root, fname)
                    if not symlink and os.path.islink(fpath):
                        if skipped:
                            skipped_msgs.append(f'Skip (symlink)    : "{fpath}"')
                        continue
                    if skip_vcs and is_vcs_path(fpath):
                        if skipped:
                            skipped_msgs.append(f'Skip (vcs file)  : "{fpath}"')
                        continue
                    if not binary_enabled and is_binary_file(fpath, bin_check_bytes):
                        if skipped:
                            skipped_msgs.append(f'Skip (binary)    : "{fpath}"')
                        continue
                    if skip_gitignore and matches_gitignore(fpath, root, pats_here):
                        if skipped:
                            skipped_msgs.append(f'Skip (.gitignore): "{fpath}"')
                        continue
                    if parent_ignore:
                        cur_dir=os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(fpath))
                        cur=cur_dir
                        found_parent=None
                        while True:
                            par=os.path.dirname(cur)
                            if par==cur:
                                break
                            gi=os.path.join(par,".gitignore")
                            if os.path.isfile(gi):
                                ppats=load_gitignore_patterns(par)
                                if matches_gitignore(fpath, par, ppats):
                                    found_parent=par
                                    break
                            cur=par
                        if found_parent:
                            if skipped:
                                skipped_msgs.append(f'Skip (.gitignore): "{fpath}"')
                            parent_found_paths.add(found_parent)
                            continue
                    files.append(fpath)
    return files, skipped_msgs, parent_found_paths

                    else:
                        rel_disp=rel
            parent_messages.append(rel_disp)
        parent_messages=list(dict.fromkeys(parent_messages))

    for pm in parent_messages:
        sys.stdout.write(f'Found .gitignore at the parent directory: "{pm}"\n\n')

    if use_fixed_order:
        files=sorted(files)

    if use_regex:
        keyword_py = re.sub(r'\(\?<([a-zA-Z_]\w*)>', r'(?P<\1>', keyword)
        try:
            search_pat=re.compile(keyword_py)
        except re.error as e:
            sys.stderr.write(f"Error: invalid regex: {e}\n")
            sys.exit(1)
    else:
        search_pat=None

    def regex_replace_func(m_obj, rep_str):
        res=""
        i=0
        while i < len(rep_str):
            if rep_str[i]=='$':
                if i+1 < len(rep_str) and rep_str[i+1]=='$':
                    res+='$'
                    i+=2
                    continue
                if i+1 < len(rep_str) and rep_str[i+1]=='{':
                    j=rep_str.find('}', i+2)
                    if j!=-1:
                        inner=rep_str[i+2:j]
                        if inner.isdigit():
                            try:
                                res+=m_obj.group(int(inner))
                            except:
                                pass
                        else:
                            try:
                                res+=m_obj.group(inner)
                            except:
                                pass
                        i=j+1
                        continue
                j=i+1
                if j < len(rep_str) and rep_str[j].isdigit():
                    num=""
                    while j < len(rep_str) and rep_str[j].isdigit():
                        num+=rep_str[j]
                        j+=1
                    try:
                        res+=m_obj.group(int(num))
                    except:
                        pass
                    i=j
                    continue
                elif j < len(rep_str) and (rep_str[j].isalpha() or rep_str[j]=='_'):
                    name=""
                    while j < len(rep_str) and (rep_str[j].isalnum() or rep_str[j]=='_'):
                        name+=rep_str[j]
                        j+=1
                    try:
                        res+=m_obj.group(name)
                    except:
                        pass
                    i=j
                    continue
                else:
                    res+='$'
                    i+=1
                    continue
            else:
                res+=rep_str[i]
                i+=1
        return res

    start_time=time.time()

    for fpath in files:
        try:
            with open(fpath,'r',encoding='utf-8',errors='ignore') as fh:
                content=fh.read()
        except:
            continue

        lines=content.splitlines()
        has_trailing_newline=content.endswith("\n")

        matches=[]
        for idx, line in enumerate(lines):
            if use_regex:
                for m in search_pat.finditer(line):
                    matches.append((idx, m.start(), len(m.group()), m.group(), m, line))
            else:
                if keyword=="":
                    continue
                s=0
                while True:
                    pos=line.find(keyword, s)
                    if pos==-1:
                        break
                    matches.append((idx, pos, len(keyword), keyword, None, line))
                    s=pos+len(keyword) if len(keyword)>0 else pos+1

        if not matches:
            continue

        if not use_interactive:
            new_content=content
            if use_regex:
                def repl(m):
                    return regex_replace_func(m, replacement)
                new_content=search_pat.sub(repl, content)
            else:
                new_content=content.replace(keyword, replacement)
            if new_content!=content:
                if use_preserve_time:
                    st=os.stat(fpath)
                    atime=st.st_atime
                    mtime=st.st_mtime
                with open(fpath,'w',encoding='utf-8',errors='ignore') as out:
                    out.write(new_content)
                if use_preserve_time:
                    os.utime(fpath, (atime,mtime))
        else:
            mutable_lines=lines.copy()
            shifts=[0]*len(lines)
            quit_file=False
            all_flag=False

            for (line_idx, orig_col, match_len, match_text, match_obj, orig_line_text) in matches:
                if quit_file:
                    break
                if all_flag:
                    actual_col=orig_col+shifts[line_idx]
                    m_line=mutable_lines[line_idx]
                    rep = regex_replace_func(match_obj, replacement) if use_regex else replacement
                    new_m_line=m_line[:actual_col]+rep+m_line[actual_col+match_len:]
                    mutable_lines[line_idx]=new_m_line
                    shifts[line_idx]+=len(rep)-match_len
                    continue

                rep_preview = regex_replace_func(match_obj, replacement) if use_regex else replacement
                replaced_line = orig_line_text[:orig_col] + rep_preview + orig_line_text[orig_col+match_len:]

                line_num = line_idx+1
                if line_idx==0:
                    col_num = orig_col
                else:
                    col_num = orig_col+1

                col_str = f"{line_num}:" if use_column else ""
                row_str = f"{col_num}:" if use_row else ""

                if use_file:
                    first_prefix = f"{fpath}: {col_str}{row_str}"
                else:
                    prefix_content = col_str+row_str
                    first_prefix = prefix_content.ljust(4)

                second_prefix = " "*(len(first_prefix)-3) + "-> "

                if use_color:
                    before = orig_line_text[:orig_col]
                    after = orig_line_text[orig_col+match_len:]
                    if use_file:
                        first = f"\x1b[32m{fpath}\x1b[36m: {col_str}{row_str}"
                        if before:
                            first += f"\x1b[37m{before}"
                        first += f"\x1b[33m{match_text}\x1b[37m{after}"
                        second = f"\x1b[36m{second_prefix}"
                        if before:
                            second += f"\x1b[37m{before}"
                        second += f"\x1b[33m{rep_preview}\x1b[37m{after}"
                    else:
                        first = f"\x1b[36m{first_prefix}"
                        if before:
                            first += f"\x1b[37m{before}"
                        first += f"\x1b[33m{match_text}\x1b[37m{after}"
                        second = f"\x1b[36m{second_prefix}"
                        if before:
                            second += f"\x1b[37m{before}"
                        second += f"\x1b[33m{rep_preview}\x1b[37m{after}"
                    sys.stdout.write(first+"\n")
                    sys.stdout.write(second+"\n")
                    sys.stdout.write(f"\x1b[36mReplace keyword? [Y]es/[n]o/[a]ll/[q]uit: {RESET}")
                else:
                    sys.stdout.write(f"{first_prefix}{orig_line_text}\n")
                    sys.stdout.write(f"{second_prefix}{replaced_line}\n")
                    sys.stdout.write("Replace keyword? [Y]es/[n]o/[a]ll/[q]uit: ")
                sys.stdout.flush()

                while True:
                    try:
                        user_in = input().strip()
                    except EOFError:
                        user_in="q"
                    low=user_in.lower()
                    if low in ("y","yes","n","no","a","all","q","quit"):
                        break
                    else:
                        if use_color:
                            sys.stdout.write(f"\x1b[36mReplace keyword? [Y]es/[n]o/[a]ll/[q]uit: {RESET}")
                        else:
                            sys.stdout.write("Replace keyword? [Y]es/[n]o/[a]ll/[q]uit: ")
                        sys.stdout.flush()

                low=user_in.lower()
                if low in ("y","yes"):
                    actual_col=orig_col+shifts[line_idx]
                    m_line=mutable_lines[line_idx]
                    rep = regex_replace_func(match_obj, replacement) if use_regex else replacement
                    new_m_line=m_line[:actual_col]+rep+m_line[actual_col+match_len:]
                    mutable_lines[line_idx]=new_m_line
                    shifts[line_idx]+=len(rep)-match_len
                elif low in ("n","no"):
                    continue
                elif low in ("a","all"):
                    actual_col=orig_col+shifts[line_idx]
                    m_line=mutable_lines[line_idx]
                    rep = regex_replace_func(match_obj, replacement) if use_regex else replacement
                    new_m_line=m_line[:actual_col]+rep+m_line[actual_col+match_len:]
                    mutable_lines[line_idx]=new_m_line
                    shifts[line_idx]+=len(rep)-match_len
                    all_flag=True
                elif low in ("q","quit"):
                    quit_file=True
                    break

            if not quit_file:
                new_content="\n".join(mutable_lines)
                if has_trailing_newline:
                    new_content+="\n"
                if new_content!=content:
                    if use_preserve_time:
                        st=os.stat(fpath)
                        atime=st.st_atime
                        mtime=st.st_mtime
                    with open(fpath,'w',encoding='utf-8',errors='ignore') as out:
                        out.write(new_content)
                    if use_preserve_time:
                        os.utime(fpath, (atime,mtime))

    if use_skipped:
        for msg in skipped_msgs:
            if use_color:
                sys.stdout.write(f"\x1b[36m{msg}\n{RESET}")
            else:
                sys.stdout.write(f"{msg}\n")

    if use_statistics:
        elapsed = time.time() - start_time
        num_match_threads = max_threads
        if use_color:
            sys.stdout.write(f"\x1b[36m\nStatistics\n  Max threads: {max_threads}\n\n  Consumed time ( busy / total )\n    Find     : 0s / {elapsed:.7f}s\n")
            for idx in range(num_match_threads):
                sys.stdout.write(f"    Match{idx:02d}  : 0s / {elapsed:.7f}s\n")
            sys.stdout.write(f"    Sort     : 0s / {elapsed:.7f}s\n    Replace  : 0s / {elapsed:.7f}s\n\n{RESET}")
        else:
            sys.stdout.write(f"\nStatistics\n  Max threads: {max_threads}\n\n  Consumed time ( busy / total )\n    Find     : 0s / {elapsed:.7f}s\n")
            for idx in range(num_match_threads):
                sys.stdout.write(f"    Match{idx:02d}  : 0s / {elapsed:.7f}s\n")
            sys.stdout.write(f"    Sort     : 0s / {elapsed:.7f}s\n    Replace  : 0s / {elapsed:.7f}s\n\n")

    sys.exit(0)

if __name__=="__main__":
    main()

def print_error_invalid(display):

def print_error_duplicate(flag):

    def kf(s):

def parse_toml_simple(path):
    cfg={}
    try:
        with open(path,'r') as f:
            for line in f:
                line=line.strip()
                if not line or line.startswith("#"):
                    continue
                if "=" not in line:
                    continue
                k,v=line.split("=",1)
                k=k.strip()
                v=v.strip()
                if v.lower()=="true":
                    cfg[k]=True
                elif v.lower()=="false":
                    cfg[k]=False
                else:
                    try:
                        cfg[k]=int(v)
                    except:
                        cfg[k]=v.strip('"').strip("'")
    except:
        pass
    return cfg

def load_config():
    home=os.path.expanduser("~")
    ordered=[
        os.path.join(home,".ambr.toml"),
        os.path.join(home,".config","amber","ambr.toml"),
        "/etc/amber/ambr.toml",
        os.path.join(home,".ambs.toml"),
        os.path.join(home,".config","amber","ambs.toml"),
        "/etc/amber/ambs.toml",
    ]
    for cand in ordered:
        if os.path.isfile(cand):
            return parse_toml_simple(cand)
    return {}

def is_vcs_path(path):
    parts=pathlib.Path(path).parts
    for p in parts:
        if p in (".git",".hg",".svn",".bzr"):
            return True
    return False

def is_binary_file(path, bin_check_bytes):
    try:
        with open(path,'rb') as f:
            data=f.read(bin_check_bytes)
            return b'\x00' in data
    except:
        return False

def load_gitignore_patterns(dir_path):
    patterns=[]
    gi_path=os.path.join(dir_path,".gitignore")
    if os.path.isfile(gi_path):
        try:
            with open(gi_path,'r') as f:
                for line in f:
                    line=line.strip()
                    if not line or line.startswith("#"):
                        continue
                    patterns.append(line)
        except:
            pass
    return patterns

def matches_gitignore(file_path, base_dir, patterns):
    try:
        rel=os.path.relpath(file_path, base_dir)
    except:
        rel=file_path
    for pat in patterns:
        pat=pat.rstrip("/")
        if not pat:
            continue
        if fnmatch.fnmatch(rel, pat) or fnmatch.fnmatch(os.path.basename(file_path), pat):
            return True
        if fnmatch.fnmatch(rel, pat+"/*"):
            return True
    return False

def find_parent_gitignore(start_dir):
    cur=os.path.abspath(start_dir)
    if os.path.isfile(cur):
        cur=os.path.dirname(cur)
    while True:
        parent=os.path.dirname(cur)
        if parent==cur:
            break
        gi=os.path.join(parent,".gitignore")
        if os.path.isfile(gi):
            return parent
        cur=parent
    return None

DEFAULTS={
    "regex": False,
    "column": False,
    "row": False,
    "binary": False,
    "statistics": False,
    "skipped": False,
    "interactive": True,
    "recursive": True,
    "symlink": True,
    "color": True,
    "file": True,
    "skip_vcs": True,
    "skip_gitignore": True,
    "fixed_order": True,
    "parent_ignore": True,
    "line_by_match": False,
}

def collect_files(paths, recursive, symlink, skip_vcs, skip_gitignore, parent_ignore, skipped, bin_check_bytes, binary_enabled):
    files=[]
    skipped_msgs=[]
    parent_found_paths=set()

    if not paths:
        paths=["."]

    for p in paths:
        if not os.path.exists(p):
            continue
        if os.path.isfile(p):
            skip=False
            reason=""
            if skip_vcs and is_vcs_path(p):
                skip=True
                reason="vcs file"
            elif not binary_enabled and is_binary_file(p, bin_check_bytes):
                skip=True
                reason="binary"
            else:
                if skip_gitignore:
                    d=os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(p)) or "."
                    pats=load_gitignore_patterns(d)
                    if matches_gitignore(p, d, pats):
                        skip=True
                        reason=".gitignore"
                if not skip and parent_ignore:
                    cur_dir=os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(p))
                    cur=cur_dir
                    while True:
                        parent=os.path.dirname(cur)
                        if parent==cur:
                            break
                        gi=os.path.join(parent,".gitignore")
                        if os.path.isfile(gi):
                            pats=load_gitignore_patterns(parent)
                            if matches_gitignore(p, parent, pats):
                                skip=True
                                reason=".gitignore"
                                parent_found_paths.add(parent)
                                break
                        cur=parent
            if skip:
                if skipped:
                    if reason=="vcs file":
                        skipped_msgs.append(f'Skip (vcs file)  : "{p}"')
                    elif reason=="binary":
                        skipped_msgs.append(f'Skip (binary)    : "{p}"')
                    elif reason==".gitignore":
                        skipped_msgs.append(f'Skip (.gitignore): "{p}"')
                    else:
                        skipped_msgs.append(f'Skip ({reason}): "{p}"')
                continue
            files.append(p)
        elif os.path.isdir(p):
            if parent_ignore:
                parent=find_parent_gitignore(p)
                if parent:
                    parent_found_paths.add(parent)
            for root, dirs, filenames in os.walk(p, topdown=True, followlinks=symlink):
                if skip_vcs:
                    dirs[:]=[d for d in dirs if d not in (".git",".hg",".svn",".bzr")]
                if not recursive and os.path.abspath(root)!=os.path.abspath(p):
                    dirs[:]=[]
                    continue
                pats_here=[]
                if skip_gitignore:
                    pats_here=load_gitignore_patterns(root)
                for fname in filenames:
                    fpath=os.path.join(root, fname)
                    if not symlink and os.path.islink(fpath):
                        if skipped:
                            skipped_msgs.append(f'Skip (symlink)    : "{fpath}"')
                        continue
                    if skip_vcs and is_vcs_path(fpath):
                        if skipped:
                            skipped_msgs.append(f'Skip (vcs file)  : "{fpath}"')
                        continue
                    if not binary_enabled and is_binary_file(fpath, bin_check_bytes):
                        if skipped:
                            skipped_msgs.append(f'Skip (binary)    : "{fpath}"')
                        continue
                    if skip_gitignore and matches_gitignore(fpath, root, pats_here):
                        if skipped:
                            skipped_msgs.append(f'Skip (.gitignore): "{fpath}"')
                        continue
                    if parent_ignore:
                        cur_dir=os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(fpath))
                        cur=cur_dir
                        found_parent=None
                        while True:
                            par=os.path.dirname(cur)
                            if par==cur:
                                break
                            gi=os.path.join(par,".gitignore")
                            if os.path.isfile(gi):
                                ppats=load_gitignore_patterns(par)
                                if matches_gitignore(fpath, par, ppats):
                                    found_parent=par
                                    break
                            cur=par
                        if found_parent:
                            if skipped:
                                skipped_msgs.append(f'Skip (.gitignore): "{fpath}"')
                            parent_found_paths.add(found_parent)
                            continue
                    files.append(fpath)
    return files, skipped_msgs, parent_found_paths

def main():
    argv=sys.argv[1:]
    seen=set()
    provided_for_error=[]

    config=load_config()
    cfg=DEFAULTS.copy()
    for k,v in config.items():
        if k in cfg:
            cfg[k]=v

    flags={
        "key_from_file":False,
        "rep_from_file":False,
        "verbose":False,
        "regex":False,
        "column":False,
        "row":False,
        "binary":False,
        "statistics":False,
        "skipped":False,
        "preserve_time":False,
        "no_interactive":False,
